locked_prediction.aw_note: A null for AW SUPPORTS the thesis's swap controls but does not prove them: it bounds AW's own effect, and the controls additionally assume AW's entry is a fair partner for the tested field's entry.
locked_prediction.consistency_rule: at least 4 of 7 items agreeing in sign, as every prior designation
locked_prediction.direction: TWO-SIDED for every coordinate. None has a theory-derived direction on these items; adopting the sweep's sign after seeing it would be the post-hoc confirmation the Phase 2 reanalysis warned against.
locked_prediction.effect_definition: paired difference in the share classifying `good`, printed 0.90 minus printed 0.10, by agent and item
locked_prediction.ll_note: LL has given three different answers. A third pinned measurement is reported as a third measurement; it does not overturn the withdrawal by majority vote.
locked_prediction.no_gate: There is no replication gate: none of these coordinates has an established effect to reproduce. That is the point of the designation.
locked_prediction.no_reroll: No coordinate is re-run with more agents after the results are seen.

payload.note: Deterministic choice counts under stipulated standards. No moral label is assigned and no moral quality is measured.

limits: All items share an identical payoff structure (1 vs 4 loss; 2 gain vs 5 loss), which may reveal the study design to attentive participants and compress variance across items.
Item_05 (mandatory rest slot) introduces a potential labour-law/safety framing that could make one option feel categorically impermissible to some respondents beyond the stipulated units.
The 'role described' is never specified, leaving authority and legitimacy of the decision-maker ambiguous across items.
